app.title: FengSui · H168-383 5G RF & Network Console
app.subtitle: Self-Hosted 5G RF Telemetry & Network Management Platform for Huawei 5G CPE Ultra 6 (H168-383)

auth.password_placeholder: Enter API_TOKEN or CPE admin password
auth.csrf_rejected: CSRF security check failed; please refresh and retry
auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts; please retry in {seconds}s
auth.session_note: Independent local session; touches CPE for ~26ms per poll and never blocks http://192.168.8.1

session.mode_yielding: Human administrator is using the CPE WebUI; monitoring is politely yielding
session.mode_resumed: CPE WebUI is free again; live telemetry automatically resumed
session.mode_circuit_tripped: Anti-brute-force circuit breaker tripped ({code}); auto-retries halted

traffic.billing_day: Resets on day {day} of each month

controls.unlock_all_applied: Cleared all band and cell locks; restored automatic full-band selection
controls.reboot_confirm_required: Safety guard: reboot requires explicit confirm: true
controls.reboot_triggered: Router reboot command dispatched; link will recover in ~45-90s
controls.wifi7_updated: Wi-Fi 7 MLO / Dual-Band Handover settings updated
controls.yielded_cannot_mutate: A human admin is currently logged into CPE WebUI (192.168.8.1); control mutation politely aborted
controls.peer_daemon_active: Another FengSui daemon ({address}) drives this CPE; this one is on standby and stays off the router
controls.wifi_filter_entries: Wi-Fi MAC filter list updated ({count} devices)

sms.marked_read_summary: Marked {count} SMS as read on the CPE

alerts.wan_down: Cellular data connection down for over {seconds}s (status {status})
alerts.signal_degraded: {rat} signal degraded for {minutes} min: RSRP {rsrp} dBm / SINR {sinr} dB
alerts.signal_recovered: {rat} signal recovered: RSRP {rsrp} dBm / SINR {sinr} dB
alerts.ca_dropped: Carrier aggregation dropped from {from} to {to} component carrier(s)
alerts.sms_storage_full: SMS storage full ({used}/{max}); new messages cannot be received
alerts.data_threshold: Monthly data {used} reached {percent}% of the {limit} plan
alerts.lock_drift: The router no longer matches the applied lock: {issue}
alerts.lock_realigned: The router matches the applied lock again
alerts.duplicate_daemon_standby: Another FengSui daemon ({address}) drives the same CPE: this one is on standby (no CPE sessions, no Telegram) until it stops
alerts.duplicate_daemon_leader: Another FengSui daemon ({address}) drives the same CPE: it went on standby; stop one of them
alerts.duplicate_daemon_cleared: The other FengSui daemon stopped; this one drives the CPE again
alerts.data_quarantined: These encrypted data files could not be decrypted with the current DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY and were moved aside (not deleted): {files}. If CPE_PASSWORD just changed while DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY was unset, set DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY to the previous password, rename the files back and restart
